name: 韩版儿童礼服公主裙款
description: 糖果粉儿童韩版公主裙，亲肤裙摆春秋两色可选

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean cream white #FFF9F5 for packshots and info shots, soft candy-pink #F7CDD3 for benefit and closing shots, cream party room for scenes
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, warm natural window light for scenes
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte candy-pink board #F7CDD3 and matte cream board #F6EFE6, light fabric drape
styleLock.iconSystem: simple rounded thin-line icons, one accent color only
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent product scale across the set, full silhouette visible
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent candy-pink childrenswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of soft candy-pink #F7CDD3, cream white #FFF9F5, sakura-red accent #D64560 and deep blue #1F3A6E; bright soft studio lighting with a front key and gentle contact shadows; rounded modern sans-serif; simple rounded thin-line icon style in one accent color; clean child-friendly fashion photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规展示完整裙型
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level front view, dress on an invisible form, full silhouette visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front key with gentle fill, soft contact shadow under the hem
shots.whitespace: none, only even margins around the dress
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level front view, the full silhouette of the dress standing centered and symmetrical, full product visible. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a soft front key and gentle fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the hem. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, with no extra whitespace beyond the even margins. 2K commercial childrenswear e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no model, no hanger wires, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative graphics, no cut-off hem, no colored background tint.

shots.intent: 一秒传达亲肤柔软与蓬松裙摆的核心利益
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle showing the front of the dress, product placed on the left
shots.lighting: soft front-left key light with gentle fill, soft contact shadow
shots.props: one thin-line icon in #1F3A6E beside the headline
shots.whitespace: generous negative space in the top-right 35% reserved for the headline
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Slight 3/4 angle showing the front of the dress, the product placed on the left of the frame. Soft front-left key light with gentle fill and a soft contact shadow. Background soft candy-pink #F7CDD3. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame; generous negative space in the top-right 35% carries the headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in sakura-red #D64560 with one thin-line icon in #1F3A6E. Negative: no more than one claim, no invented fabric percentages or efficacy claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the dress, no dense body text.

shots.intent: 放大普通童裙面料粗硬扎肤的痛点，反衬本款亲肤
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, both panels straight-on eye-level close-up on the fabric
shots.lighting: left panel flat harsh light, right panel soft gentle light
shots.background: clean white #FFFFFF panels with a thin candy-pink #F7CDD3 divider
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace inside each panel, a short label strip at the bottom
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen for {product}, two matched panels with identical camera and framing, both straight-on eye-level close-up on the fabric surface, no real person shown. Left panel: a coarse, stiff generic fabric surface under flat harsh light conveying a scratchy, uncomfortable feel. Right panel: the soft draped fabric of {product} under gentle light conveying comfort. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Both panels on clean white #FFFFFF separated by a thin candy-pink #F7CDD3 divider, soft top light. The fabric detail occupies 50-60% per panel; a short bottom label strip reads 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in charcoal #33383D, no extra whitespace inside each panel. Negative: no real model face or skin, no fabricated claims or statistics, no exaggerated before-after results, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text.

shots.intent: 生日会与演出场景代入，让家长想象孩子穿上旋转的瞬间
shots.camera: full-length slight 3/4 eye-level view of a gentle twirl pose, candid feel
shots.lighting: warm natural window light from the left, 5500K, soft shadows
shots.background: cream #F6EFE6 party room wall with pastel decor
shots.props: pastel balloons and a low dessert table kept away from the dress
shots.whitespace: none, the environment fills the rest of the frame
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene of {product} at a children's birthday party. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Full-length slight 3/4 eye-level view of a generic child model shown only from behind in a gentle twirl so the skirt flares, no face visible. Warm natural window light from the left, 5500K, soft shadows. Background a cream #F6EFE6 party room wall with pastel balloons and a low dessert table kept away from the dress. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame, no extra whitespace, the environment fills the rest. Negative: no recognizable child face, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics, no hands covering the dress, no clutter covering the product, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 微距证明面料织纹与裙边缝制工艺
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle
shots.lighting: soft directional side light skimming across the surface revealing weave texture, shallow depth of field
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the fabric of {product}, tight zoom on the weave and the neatly stitched hem, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground threads sharp, soft directional side light skimming across the surface revealing the weave texture. Background a matte candy-pink board #F7CDD3. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with minimal whitespace, the texture is the subject. A small bottom-left label reads 「{callout_3}」 in deep blue #1F3A6E. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented thread counts or fabric percentages, no props, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text.

shots.intent: 平铺展示裙型比例，用留空表格消除选码疑虑
shots.camera: flat lay from directly above at a 90-degree overhead angle, dress neatly spread with sleeves symmetrical
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: a structured spec card with empty table cells and blank dimension callout lines in #33383D
shots.whitespace: right-side 30% column reserved for the spec card
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce size spec infographic for {product}, flat lay from directly above at a 90-degree overhead angle with the dress neatly spread and sleeves symmetrical. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting with no dramatic shadow. Background pure white #FFFFFF. The dress occupies 55-60% of the frame; the right-side 30% column holds a structured spec card with empty table cells and blank dimension callout lines in charcoal #33383D plus one filled label 「{callout_4}」, dimension arrows in sakura-red #D64560. Negative: no fabricated measurements or size numbers, keep table cells empty, no dense body text, no unreadable tiny text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 并列两色让买家快速选色，同机位同光保证色准
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, both colorways standing side by side
shots.lighting: identical soft studio lighting across both variants, soft contact shadows
shots.props: small color-name tags above each dress
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace between the pair
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant presentation of {product} in two colorways, crimson red #C13A4E and deep blue #1F3A6E, both at an identical slight 3/4 hero angle with identical lighting. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The two dresses stand side by side on soft candy-pink #F7CDD3 with soft contact shadows. Together the products occupy 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace between the pair. Small color-name tags 「{callout_5}」 and 「{callout_6}」 above each dress in charcoal #33383D. Negative: no lighting drift between variants, no invented color names beyond the placeholders, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text.

shots.intent: 以缝制细节与留空洗护图标行降低决策风险
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level close-up on the waistband stitching and lined bodice edge
shots.lighting: even clean studio light, no harsh speculars
shots.props: three empty rounded care-icon frames in a bottom strip
shots.whitespace: bottom strip reserved for the care-icon frames
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level close-up on the waistband stitching, the lined bodice edge and a blank fabric care-label area. Even clean studio light, no harsh speculars. Background pure white #FFFFFF. The detail occupies 50-60% of the frame; a bottom strip holds three empty rounded care-icon frames with one short label 「{callout_7}」 in deep blue #1F3A6E. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, test reports, antibacterial standards or awards, keep the badge frames empty, no readable invented care numbers, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text.

shots.intent: 收口促单，用主色背景与行动按钮完成转化
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, full dress visible on the left
shots.lighting: punchier soft studio light with a gentle spotlight on the skirt, soft contact shadow
shots.background: solid candy-pink #F7CDD3 with a soft white #FFFFFF rounded CTA panel
shots.props: a rounded CTA panel on the right
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the right 35% for the CTA panel
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Slight 3/4 hero angle with the full dress visible on the left, slightly punchier soft studio light with a gentle spotlight on the skirt. Background solid candy-pink #F7CDD3 with a soft white #FFFFFF rounded CTA panel. The product occupies 55-60% of the frame; the right 35% is generous negative space holding a short headline 「{selling_point_2}」 and a CTA button 「{callout_8}」 in sakura-red #D64560. Negative: no invented discounts, prices or countdowns, no real offer numbers, no watermark, no fake logo, no dense text, no cut-off hem.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：P1 为粉色糖果主题头图，标题标明儿童韩版礼服公主裙，信息栏列出两色可选、面料纯棉、儿童岁码档尺码与适合春秋季节；P2 为指数说明条(弹力/厚度/版型三档指示)、洗护图标行与尺码表(列名含胸围/腰围/肩宽/衣长/袖长，各行数值全部相同疑似占位，不采信)，下接两色色块展示；P3 为模特展示区与色差提示条，图区为空白粉底；P4 为四宫格画册版式；P5-P6 为空白粉底画册页，未承载产品信息。品类判定：信息栏品名为外穿韩版礼服公主裙，尺码行为儿童岁码档(非月龄段)，成衣形态为外穿连衣裙，故判为 母婴/童装 而非 内衣家居服/儿童内衣。已剥离：黑猫头店铺图形标识、卡通形象贴片、英文装饰语与原文案原句、尺码表实测数值(改 {callout_n} 与空白表格单元)、洗护图标行的水温漂白熨烫数值、模特面容与身份、原平台店铺字样；两色与纯棉为图面明示事实仅作通用描述，产品一律以 {product} 占位。
